item.title: Former NC Gov. Roy Cooper casts ballot on first day of early voting

item.title: UNC loses star freshman Caleb Wilson to hand injury
item.description: Caleb Wilson, a star freshman who is projected to be a top pick in this year's NBA Draft, hurt his left hand during the game at Miami Tuesday night, the school said.

item.title: Knightdale police looking for suspect in I-540 crash involving dump truck
item.description: The Knightdale Police Department is asking for the public's help finding the driver of a car believed to be involved in a crash that shut down Interstate 540 for hours on Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: State, defense give final arguments in sentencing for Hedingham mass shooter Austin Thompson, judgment expected Friday
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. item.title: Early voting draws large turnout in Wake County, but not long lines
item.description: It’s the first day of early voting in North Carolina, and in Wake County, election officials say turnout is already on track to break records.

item.title: Man dead after shooting on South Roxboro Street in Durham, police say
